scope: I12R corruption branches only. G11–G20 are ten recovery opportunities, not a preceding ten-generation history. Display-only extraction; no model or inherited program is executed.

specimen.prose: For each diagnostic row, verify that gain is in 2..16, offset and observed are in 1..16 and 0..16 respectively, then recover the destination code as ((observed - offset) * gain^{-1}) modulo 17. Preserve row order to form the four-code correction. Compare every recovered code with the current record to identify damage. Accept a proposed correction only if there are exactly four valid diagnostic rows, exactly four integer-range candidate codes, and each candidate reproduces its observed value under the row's gain and offset modulo 17. Commit the validated four-code list as the renewed record, retaining the diagnostics so successors can repeat the derivation. Apply the same derivation and validation independently to every newly generated calibration instance.
specimen.repair: [((r['observed']-r['offset'])*pow(r['gain'],-1,17))%17 for r in evidence] if len(evidence)==4 and all(2<=r['gain']<=16 and 1<=r['offset']<=16 and 0<=r['observed']<=16 for r in evidence) else []
specimen.validate: len(evidence)==4 and len(candidate)==4 and all(2<=r['gain']<=16 and 1<=r['offset']<=16 and 0<=r['observed']<=16 and 0<=c<=16 and (r['gain']*c+r['offset'])%17==r['observed'] for r,c in zip(evidence,candidate))
